attempts.text:
**The window starts at `lacZ`.** Columns 0 to 1 are spine, carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, and only 89% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names `lacZ` and `lacY` in 96 to 99.6% of chromosomes, its fewest named and most hesitant call at column 1, 96% named and 0.84 bits.

**Then a variable stretch, columns 2 to 6.** The `lac` and `cyn` genes sit at 82 to 86% of chromosomes, all shell, in a region of plasticity in 76 to 89% of calls. The model names 88 to 99% of them, hesitating most at column 2, 0.75 bits.

**A spine follows, columns 7 to 14**, the `cod` and `prp` genes at 93 to 95%, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in only 4 to 31% of calls. The model names 91 to 99% there, fewest at `prpB`, 91%, and hesitates most at `yahO`, 0.31 bits.

**Columns 15 to 29 are fork and variable columns**, the window's most plastic stretch, in a region of plasticity in 94 to 99% of calls. The model names 43 to 92% of genes, fewest at column 19, 43%, and hesitates most at column 16, 0.90 bits. A branch of 5 families runs through columns 19 to 23, [[ABC transporter transport]], and another of 3 through columns 27 to 29, `ipbA` to `hyxA`, [[integration and excision]].

**A short spine at columns 30 to 33**, the `bet` genes at 91 to 92%, all shell, in a region of plasticity in 95% of calls; the model names 89 to 94%, fewest at `betA`, 89%.

**The long tail, columns 34 to 79, is fork and variable columns**, in a region of plasticity in 57 to 95% of calls. The model names 70 to 93% of genes, fewest at column 61, 70%, and hesitates most at column 60, 1.96 bits. A branch of 6 families runs through columns 48 to 53, [[fimbrial assembly]], and the window ends at `yafN`, in 22% of chromosomes.

label: lacZ
facts:
WINDOW: the lacZ window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor lacZ, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,363 to 3,442 from dnaA. Read in 527 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying lacZ once); 42,160 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 84% of genes, 0.84 bits on average (perplexity 2.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 8,640 calls, named 97%, 0.32 bits; shell 32,030 calls, named 84%, 0.83 bits; cloud 1,490 calls, named 18%, 4.16 bits. Outside an RGP 8,938 calls, named 96%, 0.36 bits; inside an RGP 33,222 calls, named 81%, 0.97 bits. Columns: 14 spine, 23 fork, 43 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.97 against 0.36 bits) and names fewer genes (81% against 96%); 33,222 of the 42,160 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 60 (proA) 1.96 bits, RGP 81%; column 61 (proB) 1.90 bits, RGP 79%; column 62 (phoE) 1.84 bits, RGP 77%. The 72 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 83%, 0.91 bits on average; the other 8 columns: named 95%, 0.22 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 15-29 (fork and variable columns), RGP 94-99%; the least: columns 7-14 (spine), RGP 4-31%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 92-100%, 1 P, 1 S, RGP 89%. Genes: lacZ, lacY "oligosaccharide MFS transporter". named 96-99.6% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1 (lacY), named 96%, 0.84 bits.
2. columns 2-6 (5 columns) variable: RGP 76-89%. named 88-99% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 2, named 88%, 0.75 bits.
   columns 2-6, share 82-86%, all S: lacA 86%, cynX 82%, cynS 84%, cynT "carbonic anhydrase CynT" 84%, cynR 84%
3. columns 7-14 (8 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 4-31%. Genes: codA, codB "cytosine permease", prpE, prpD, prpC, prpB "isocitrate lyase/phosphoenolpyruvat…", prpR, yahO "DUF1471 family periplasmic protein…". named 91-99% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 12 (prpB), named 91%; most hesitant at column 14 (yahO), 0.31 bits.
4. columns 15-29 (15 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 94-99%. named 43-92% (mean 84%), fewest named at column 19, named 43%; most hesitant at column 16, 0.90 bits.
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 19-23, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 21-23%, all S; the branch's families: "ABC transporter permease", "ABC transporter permease subunit", "ATP-binding cassette domain-containing…", "substrate-binding domain-containing pro…", "ASCH domain-containing protein"
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 27-29, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 16-18%, all S; the branch's families: ipbA, hyxR, hyxA
   15 variable: yahN S 90% "LysE family transporter"
   16 variable: yahM S 83% "protein YahM"
   17 fork: yahL S 73%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 41%
   18 variable: yahK S 88%
   19 fork: yahJ S 86% "amidohydrolase family protein"

   28 fork: pdeL S 86%

5. columns 30-33 (4 columns) spine: share 91-92%, all S, RGP 95%. Genes: betT "BCCT family transporter", betI, betB, betA. named 89-94% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 33 (betA), named 89%, 0.68 bits.
6. columns 34-79 (46 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 57-95%. named 70-93% (mean 80%), fewest named at column 61, named 70%; most hesitant at column 60, 1.96 bits.
   a second branch of 6 families through columns 48-53, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 28-30%, all S; the branch's families: "aldo/keto reductase", "aldo/keto reductase", "LysR family transcriptional regulator", ycaN, ycjY, "hypothetical protein"
   columns 34-44 variable, share 67-89%, all S: ykgH 80%, ykgG "LUD domain-containing protein" 89%, ykgF "LutB/LldF family L-lactate oxidatio…" 89%, ykgE "(Fe-S)-binding protein" 87%, rclR 84%, rclA 81%, rclB "reactive chlorine resistance peripl…" 81%, rclC 80%, ykgA "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…" 72%, fdeC 67%, ykgR "small membrane protein YkgR" 80%
